Bench: M.R. Shah, C.T. Ravikumar  IN THE SUPREME COURT OF INDIA  CIVIL APPELLATE JURISDICTION  CIVIL APPEAL NO. 2728 OF 2023  (Arising from SLP(C) No. 7476 OF 2023  @ Diary No(s).7105/2023)
 SURYAKANT ...Appellant(s)
 Versus  THE STATE OF HARYANA & ORS. Respondent(s)
 O R D E R Delay condoned.
Issue notice.

On the advance copy being served at the instance of the Court, Dr. Monika Gusain, learned counsel accepts notice on behalf of the respondent(s)/State of Haryana.
Leave granted.

Feeling aggrieved and dissatisfied with the impugned judgment and order dated 04-03-2022 passed by the High Court of Punjab & Haryana at Chandigarh in Regular First Appeal No.1134 of 2021 (O&M) by which the High Court has reduced the amount of compensation to Rs.750/- per square yard, the original landowner/claimant has preferred the present appeal.

The issue involved in the present appeal is squarely covered by the decision of this Court dated 17.10.2022 contd..
- 2 - in the case of Radhey Sham Vs. The State of Haryana and others in Civil Appeal No.7391 of 2022 by which against the very impugned judgment and order, this Court has enhanced the amount of compensation to Rs.1,000/- per square yard.

opennyai_summary.decision:
Feeling aggrieved and dissatisfied with the impugned judgment and order dated 04-03-2022 passed by the High Court of Punjab & Haryana at Chandigarh in Regular First Appeal No.1134 of 2021 (O&M) by which the High Court has reduced the amount of compensation to Rs.750/- per square yard, the original landowner/claimant has preferred the present appeal.
and the impugned judgment and order passed by the High Court is modified to that extent awarding the compensation to the appellant at the rate of Rs.1,000/- per square yard with all other statutory benefits including the interest which may be available under the provisions of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894.
The present Appeal is allowed to the aforesaid extent.
On the advance copy being served at the instance of the Court, Dr. Monika Gusain,
learned counsel accepts notice on behalf of the respondent(s)/State of Haryana.
Leave granted.
The appeal is allowed in terms of the signed order.
Pending application(s) shall stand disposed of.
